summary: Re-verification of the Smart Medication fixes from iteration_93. Testing ran ONLY against the Preview base URL https://visita-admin.preview.emergentagent.com and local Mongo (mongodb://localhost:27017, test_database). No Production data was touched. Backend: new pytest file test_smart_med_reverify.py, run sequentially: 12/13 pass. Frontend: Playwright as physician and admin. Results per QA assertion: [PASS] FIX parser: organize of the 5-line text returns 5 items: Metformin ALREADY_ON_LIST, Ramipril SIG_DIFFERENCE, Amlodipine POSSIBLE_RESTART (it was discontinued), Atorvastatin POSSIBLE_DOSE_CHANGE with match af0e53b7, Vitamin D POSSIBLE_RESTART. API and UI cards agree. [PASS] FIX IDOR: reconcile flag, update_sig, replace and restart with another patient's match_id leave that med unchanged in Mongo (review_flag, sig, active, strength, history, updated_at). The same holds for a /prescriptions/{id}/complete flag decision. [PASS] Duplicate prevention: a second 'add' is reported in skipped as '(duplicate)' and only 1 active row exists. [PASS] No Rx transmission: rx_transmissions 6→6 and prescription_requests unchanged across organize, reconcile and the external completion. [PASS] portal_visible: false hides the med from GET /api/portal/medications and from the Portal Preview; true restores it. The UI toggle mr-med-visibility switches 'Visible'↔'Hidden' with no reload. [PASS with caveat] External verification UI: act-complete → the VIen outcome is disabled (no transmission) → prescription_verified_external → preview lists 3 ⚠ items and 1 + item → submit stays disabled until confirm is checked → 200. Only the ADD_MISSING item was added. Ramipril, Atorvastatin and Vitamin D were flagged, with strength/SIG/active unchanged. completion_outcome=PRESCRIPTION_VERIFIED_EXTERNAL, verified_by=Kevin Rodriguez, status=completed_external_verified. The patient overview shows 'Processed by clinic — external prescription verified'. CAVEAT (FAIL in pytest): the server trusts the classification sent by the client. A forged decision 'add' with classification POSSIBLE_DOSE_CHANGE (Atorvastatin 40 mg) is accepted and creates a SECOND active Atorvastatin row. [PASS] Dose/SIG never silently overwritten: UI defaults are flag for SIG_DIFFERENCE, POSSIBLE_DOSE_CHANGE and POSSIBLE_RESTART, and skip for ALREADY_ON_LIST. Apply with the defaults reads 'Apply 0 changes · flag 4', leaves strength/SIG untouched and shows 'Needs review' rows. Replace discontinues the old row (history discontinued, reason dose_change, strength preserved) and inserts a new row; nothing is edited in place. [PASS] Restart: a flag leaves Vitamin D inactive; only 'restart' reactivates it (active true, history restarted). [PASS] Portal Preview: the medicines (drug+strength) equal /api/portal/medications, the hidden med is excluded, and appointment/request/referral ids equal /api/portal/overview and documents equal /api/portal/documents (0). Muted texts compute to rgb(100,116,139): 0 of 64 text nodes are white. The light background rgb(244,247,251) fills the viewport (1080/1080). There are no buttons or inputs; the only link is 'Back to patient'. [PASS] Regression: '+ Add medication' with drug/strength/SIG and blank refills returns 200 in both API and UI. After Stop and after Resume, all Stop/Edit/Continue/Resume buttons are enabled immediately, with no reload. [PASS] Rendering: no 'mg mg' or 'IU IU' in Medical Record rows, the Medical Record API, portal medications or the Preview (Rosuvastatin shows '5 mg'). No lone '}' line in the page text. Cleanup done: test meds discontinued (Amlodipine, Lisinopril, Perindopril and TEST_* incl. TEST_UI_Ramipril), every review_flag on Maria cleared, portal_visible=true on all of Maria's meds, and the Vitamin D SIG restored to '2 tablets daily' (the restart test had overwritten it). Maria's active list is back to Metformin/Ramipril/Atorvastatin.

critical.issue: The server trusts the classification sent by the client. rx_complete filters only by decision type (add/skip/flag). A forged decision {decision:'add', classification:'POSSIBLE_DOSE_CHANGE', med: Atorvastatin 40 mg} is applied and creates a second ACTIVE Atorvastatin row next to the existing 20 mg row. This breaks the rule that external verification adds ONLY ADD_MISSING items. Reproduced by test_external_cannot_add_conflicting_dose. Fix: in rx_complete, recompute the classification on the server with recon_mod.organize(refs, items=_rx_request_meds(doc)). Accept 'add' only for items the server classifies as ADD_MISSING, and turn any other 'add' into 'flag'. In reconcile, require an explicit 'add_both' decision when an active match for the same drug exists.

minor.issue: The applied/flagged labels lose the unit after the strength split, e.g. 'TEST_Candesartan_910b 8 — added' and 'Ramipril 10'. Build the label before splitting strength and unit, or include unit.

_regimen_key compares the exact SIG text, so 'OD' and 'daily' for the same drug and strength are not treated as duplicates. Flags on POSSIBLE_RESTART are still written to DISCONTINUED rows, which never render a 'Needs review' badge.

An explicit restart overwrites the stored SIG and source with the pasted values (Vitamin D '2 tablets daily' became 'daily'). This is acceptable because it is explicit, but the previous SIG is not recorded in the 'restarted' history event.

action_items: HIGH: In external verification (and in reconcile 'add'), validate the classification on the server. Never accept 'add' for an item the server classifies as POSSIBLE_DOSE_CHANGE, SIG_DIFFERENCE, POSSIBLE_RESTART or REVIEW_REQUIRED.
Minor: keep the unit in the applied/flagged labels.
Minor: raise the contrast of the amber classification badges on Smart Paste cards in the dark theme.

server.py MedWriteBody: the refills field_validator sits in the middle of the field list. It works, but move it below the fields for readability.
PortalPreview profile card falls back to JSON.stringify(profile_completion) if status is missing, which could render raw braces. Not seen for Maria.

rca of the issue: Forged-add: recon_mod.apply runs the 'add' branch for any decision='add' and only checks regimen_key duplicates. regimen_key includes strength, so 40 mg differs from the existing 20 mg row and the insert succeeds. rx_complete restricts decision types but not their pairing with the server-side classification. Repro: POST /api/internal/prescriptions/{TEST id}/complete {outcome: PRESCRIPTION_VERIFIED_EXTERNAL, confirm_external: true, decisions: [{med: {drug: 'Atorvastatin', strength: '40 mg', sig: 'HS'}, classification: 'POSSIBLE_DOSE_CHANGE', decision: 'add', match_id: ATORVA}]} → 2 active Atorvastatin rows. Mitigation: reclassify on the server and downgrade a non-ADD_MISSING 'add' to 'flag'.
